ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d1_recept_: Party in the &6Bubble Bowl&r! &dSquidmika&r has to perform against Squilliam and has no band. You grab the drum, the whole town sings along.
The alarm bell of &6The Krusty Nibble&r is ringing! Run to the office of &dMr. Krabguh&r, at the back of the restaurant. Something is up with his safe...
&dPlankmika&r has the secret recipe! Sneak through his lab in &6The Grease Bucket&r, past &dKaren&r's cameras and lasers. Being seen only puts you back at the last rest point.
Bring the secret recipe back to &dMr. Krabguh&r. We won't give away the secret ingredient. (It is a cheese nibble.)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.hint.10: To the Bubble Bowl, the round stadium in the north, %s. Your drum is on the stage; the little steps are at the side.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.hint.7: The alarm bell! Mr. Krabguh is calling you: his office is at the back of The Krusty Nibble, %s. Walk in, past the till, the door at the back.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.hint.8: The Grease Bucket is the big grey bucket across the street, %s. Spongeguh keeps watch at the door.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.hint.9: Bring the recipe to Mr. Krabguh: his office at the back of The Krusty Nibble, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.bijna: Karen almost sees you%s Out of the yellow patch!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.onder: Yellow = Karen is looking. Red = laser. Crouch = quieter.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.rustp: Rest point %s of %s: you start here again if Karen sees you.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.stand: Sneaking: rest point %s of %s  ·  Karen saw you %s times
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.trommel.bij: %s of the %s. Squidmika counts in again...
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.trommel.ond: Click the drum when the bubble pops: %s of the %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.trommel.weg: The band is waiting for you: stand behind your drum again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.weg.onder: Plankmika is coming with the menu: run outside!
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.beloni: Eight Nibble Patties, fresh off the grill
The secret Nibble Patty recipe: from now on the grill bakes for you
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.10: Tonight there is a party in the Bubble Bowl, the big round stadium in the north of town (follow Bubble Lane from the square). Squidmika has to perform and you are his drummer! Climb onto the stage by the little steps at the side and stand behind the drum.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.10_: Hit the drum when a bubble pops on it: click exactly when the ring of bubbles touches the drum. Ten of the sixteen is enough, and missing costs nothing: Squidmika simply counts in again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.7: The alarm bell of The Krusty Nibble is ringing! Run to Mr. Krabguh: his office is at the back of the restaurant, the door at the back right behind the till. Something terrible has happened to his safe.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.8: Plankmika has stolen the secret recipe! Cross the street to The Grease Bucket, the big grey bucket opposite The Krusty Nibble. At the back, in the lab, the recipe lies in a little safe. Stay out of Karen's cameras (the yellow patches on the floor) and only walk through a red laser when it is off.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.8_b: You have the recipe! Plankmika thinks you are a customer and is coming with the menu. Run back outside the way you came: through the corridor and the empty bucket to the street.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.9: You have the recipe! Bring it to Mr. Krabguh, in his office at the back of The Krusty Nibble, across the street.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.kla: The secret recipe is back and Squidmika is (for one evening) a star! Mr. Krabguh will have big news soon...
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.1: The stage of the Bubble Bowl, the stadium in the north (up Bubble Lane)
Behind your drum on the stage of the Bubble Bowl
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.7: Mr. Krabguh's office, at the back of The Krusty Nibble (on Main Street, east of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.8: The Grease Bucket: the big grey bucket opposite The Krusty Nibble
The front door of The Grease Bucket, on the street
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.9: Mr. Krabguh, in his office at the back of The Krusty Nibble
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.beloning: For your guhs: Spongeguh's square trousers with a tie! And %s Nibble Patties. From now on the grill in The Krusty Nibble bakes for you too.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.buiten: Outside! Behind you sounds a very small, very cross "KAREEEN!". Off to Mr. Krabguh, across the street.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klaar: Part 1 is done: The Secret Recipe! Come back soon: Mr. Krabguh has big news, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.bewo: Tonight: Squidmika in the Bubble Bowl! I'm bringing earplugs. Or not? I'm bringing them. Just in case.
Have you heard? There's been a break-in at The Krusty Nibble! The recipe is gone!
Without Nibble Patties I'll eat... grease today? No, then rather nothing.
The recipe is back, they say! I'm going to queue up right away!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.gerr: Nyeg! (Gary taps his tail to the beat.)
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.krab: Tonight I'm selling Nibble Patties in the Bubble Bowl. At the entrance. At double the price. A party is a party!
My office! Now! At the back! Something TERRIBLE has happened!
Every minute without the recipe costs me... (counts on his claws) ...THREE cheese nibbles! Hurry up!
Have you got it? HAVE YOU GOT IT? Come to my office, the walls have ears here. And customers.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.octo: Tonight I play against Squilliam. With a block of cheese as singer and a newbie on the drum. Sigh.
A stolen recipe. Maybe it's a sign. A sign that I should have the day off.
If Plankmika catches you, can I take over your shift? No? Sigh.
The recipe is back. Hooray. I'm overjoyed. Can you tell? No? That's right.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.pare: I hope they play something you can dance to. Something from now. Not something from Daddy's time.
Daddy is shouting even louder than usual! That means: something with money.
Careful in that bucket. Everything smells of grease in there. Yuck.
Daddy is dancing! Daddy NEVER dances! What did you do?
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.patg: I'm going to stand at the front. I made a sign: 'SQUID'. I didn't know how to spell the rest.
I heard a bell. I thought: ice cream man. It wasn't the ice cream man.
Sneaking? I'm very good at that. I sneak out of bed every morning. Very slowly.
What's a recipe? Is that a kind of sandwich?
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.plan: I am NOT going to that party. I'm staying home to make a new plan. Plan AA. Very evil.
Recipe? What recipe? I know nothing. I'm just a very small Mika.
A customer?! In MY restaurant? Karen, get the grease balls!
The recipe is GONE! Karen! Who did that? ...Why are you looking at me like that, Karen?
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.klik.spon: My singing voice is warmed up. Lalalaaa! Yes, it's warm. Maybe too warm.
Do you hear that bell? That's the Krabguh bell! It only rings for fire, for money or for... money on fire!
I'd come along, but I squeak when I sneak. Listen: (squeak) ...see?
You've got the recipe?! I knew it! I didn't know it, but I KNEW it!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.plankmika: Sir! Madam! Wait a moment! I have a menu!
Grease balls of the day! Buy two, pay for two!
Karen, why is our customer running AWAY?!
Come back! The grease is still warm! Roughly!
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.gez: Bleep. I see something moving, honey. Oh, it's the draught. Back to your spot.
Bleep. An intruder? Oh no, just a block of cheese with ears. Off you go, back.
Bleep-bleep. I saw you. I won't tell Plankmika. This time.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.las: Bleep! Laser touched. That tickles, doesn't it? Back to square one, honey.
Bleep! Red means: wait a moment. Try again.
Bleep! My lovely laser. It was just polished.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.reg: Sneaking: stay out of the yellow patches on the floor (a camera of Karen's is looking there) and only walk through a red laser when it is off. Crouching makes you quieter: then a camera only sees you up close. Seen? Then you simply stand at the last rest point again.
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.sluip.tro: (Nothing wrong: you are back at the last rest point. Watch how the camera swings to and fro, and go when it looks the other way.)
quest.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept.trommel.r: Drumming: click the drum (left or right mouse button) as soon as a bubble pops on it. %s of the %s is enough. Missing costs nothing: Squidmika simply counts in again.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.avo: And so, mes amis, we went to the Bubble Bowl that evening. With a drum. And a great deal of hope.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.ban: Only my band walked out yesterday. They found my music 'too beautiful'. They said. Roughly.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.dom: That is the dumbest thing I have ever heard. ...Do you have anyone for the drum?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.fee: This calls for a celebration! Tonight I'm throwing a party in the Bubble Bowl, with free Nibble Patties! ...Half. Half free.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.hel: You did it! You're a hero! A sneaking hero!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.rec: MY RECIPE! Come to daddy, my little money machine!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.rit: You, newbie! You have rhythm. I could tell from your sneaking.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.sta: Squidmika! You don't need a band. The whole town is your band!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_feest.uit: Tonight? In the Bubble Bowl? That's where Squilliam challenges me. He plays, I play, and the town chooses.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_kijk_kant: There, at the back of The Krusty Nibble: the office with the safe.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_kijk_podi: The Bubble Bowl: your drum stands on the right of the stage. The little steps are at the side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_kijk_teru: Mr. Krabguh is waiting in his office, across the street.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_kijk_vete: The big grey bucket across the street. At the back: Plankmika's lab.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_knipoog_k: If you clone the recipe, you'll have two!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.be: Thank you Karen, my computer wife.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.ee: There is only one creature in all of Bikini Bottom who is so mean... and so small...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.ge: Who would do something so mean?!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.ha: Mr. Krabguh, we'll get it back!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.ji: You there, newbie! Plankmika doesn't know your face yet. Sneak into The Grease Bucket, across the street, and get my recipe back!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.kl: The safe is empty! Last night my recipe was still in it. And now? Nothing! Zero! Zilch!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.kr: A creak. A squeak. And then: a very small, very mean giggle.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.la: There's one more drawer in the cabinet, honey.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.mi: Plan A to Y: all failed! I am a genius without a plan, Karen!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.na: That night, while all of Bikini Bottom lay snoring...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.oc: And so, mes amis, we are back at this morning.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.st: Step one: wait until it's dark. Step two: take the recipe. Step three: NIBBLE PATTIES!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.te: Ah, mes amis... let us rewind a little. To last night, across the street, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.vr: Does this mean I have the day off?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.wa: And I'll keep watch at the door! Very inconspicuously! ...VERY INCONSPICUOUSLY!
Mr. Krabguh! I heard the bell! What happened?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_plan_z.we: MY RECIPE! My secret Nibble Patty recipe is GONE!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.al: Of course. It is always a cheese nibble.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.ie: Bleep. Someone is standing by the recipe, honey.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.kl: Someone? A CUSTOMER?! Finally a customer! Karen, switch off the security, I'm coming with the menu!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.le: The secret ingredient of the Nibble Patty is...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.op: Ah! The little safe opens, and there it lies: the secret recipe, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_recept.we: This, mes amis, is the moment to get out of here very, very quickly.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_sluip_uit: Inside, Karen watches through cameras. Where the floor lights up yellow, she sees you. Wait until she looks the other way.
The red lasers blink: on, off, on. Walk through when they're off. And crouching makes you quieter!
Psssst! Over here! I'm the lookout. Nobody sees me. I'm a bush.
Seen? No problem: then you're back at the last little rest point. The recipe is all the way at the back, in a little safe.
Good luck! I'll wave when I can't see you anymore. ...I'll wave already.
The worst lookout in Bikini Bottom
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_recept_zoete_zeg: Ah, the Bubble Bowl! Tonight: the great music contest. All of Bikini Bottom is here, nyeg.
And so, mes amis, the secret recipe came home, and Squidmika Tentacles was the hero of Bikini Bottom for one evening. One evening, nyeg.
Ha! Squidmika! Where is your orchestra? All I see is a block of cheese and a newbie with a drum!
A silence. And then... cheering. A great deal of cheering.
This is a mistake. This is an enormous mistake.
And I've sold four hundred Nibble Patties! At the entrance! At double the price!
